en:
We can't stay here forever.
Let's go investigate other spots.

We don't have time to be lazing around!
Isn't that right, sidekick!?
Yeah, you're right.

Hmm, so this is the pool...
It's not much like a school pool.

So that window we investigated above the stage
in the gym connects to here, right?

The culprit probably got in and out from here! 
Alright! Investigate every nook and cranny!
<CLT=cltMIND>...You're not gonna do it yourself?

So that window we investigated above the stage
in the gym connects to here, right?

The culprit probably got in and out from here! 
Alright! Investigate every nook and cranny!

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

I came all the way here...
I should look everywhere.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is deep, but it isn't filled
up all the way. Still, plenty of water to swim in.

<CLT=cltMIND>The water level hasn't changed...
but I can see something floating in it.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the pool's equipment shed.
I'll take a look inside, just in case.
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>An electric air pump?

<CLT=cltMIND>I see... You could easily fill a large
inner tube with this.

There doesn't seem to be anything else
worth inspecting.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the pool's tool shed.
Over there...

<CLT=cltMIND>is an electric air pump. You could
fill a large inner tube with that easily.

There doesn't seem to be anything else
worth inspecting.
<CLT=cltMIND>You can see the gym's window over there...

That's the window we investigated from 
on top of the stage in the gym.

I mean...it's pretty high up. You wouldn't be 
able to reach it with just a ladder.

I agree... The ladder only barely reached
the window, and it was on the stage.

If that's the case, then it might've been hard
for someone to have gone through there...
Yeah, you might be right.

<CLT=cltMIND>The window over there is the gym
window. It's really high up...

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't seem like you could reach it
from here, even with a ladder.

<CLT=cltMIND>It would be difficult for someone
to go in and out from there.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's the window to the shower room
in Ryoma's lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large diving board.
It looks like something you'd find at a resort...
<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing about it has changed.

<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
There's one that I find peculiar...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also some specifications
written here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is 82 feet in length
and is 39 feet wide...

<CLT=cltMIND>The poolside is 13 feet on each end,
and the left and right sides are 8 feet each...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's something bothering me
about the pool rules. They say...

Oh! No jumping into the pool!
Especially at nighttime!
Whoa! Where'd you come from!?

I mean, jumping itself is fine. If you wanna
jump in front of a car or a train, that's on you.

But the pool is off-limits at nighttime.
See? "<CLT=cltSTRONG>No swimming at nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
That would be a violation, right?

If anyone violates a school regulation, a
campus-wide siren will blare...

And then that person will be rrrrrripped
apart by the Exisals!
Y-You'd go that far?

Well, so far the siren hasn't gone off.
So no one's needed to be ripped apart...
...yet. Puhuhu.

Since that's the case...can we assume no
one was in the gym or pool at nighttime?
...Well, at the very least, no one alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>No swimming at nighttime...
That just might play into this case.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Pool Rules<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's something bothering me
about the pool rules. They say...

No jumping in the pool!
I repeat, no jumping in the pool!

Especially at nighttime!
Especially at nighttime!
Whoa! He's back!

If anyone violates a school regulation...
If anyone violates a school regulation...

A campus-wide siren will blare...
A campus-wide siren will blare...

And then that person!
And then that person!

Will be ripped apart!
Will be ripped apart!

By the Exisals!
By the Exisals!

Shut up already! We get it!
No need to repeat yourself!

No sirens have gone off...
And no one has been "ripped apart"...

Can we then assume that no one
was in the gym or pool at nighttime?

...Well, at the very least, no one alive.
...Well, at the very least, no one alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>No swimming at nighttime...
That just might play into this case.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's something else I have to investigate.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's an inner tube floating in the pool!
It looks like a big, sturdy, rubber one.

Let me guess...some idiots didn't clean up 
after themselves.
Don't look at us.
I don't like water. I prefer juice.

We get heavier when our cotton absorbs
water. It makes losing weight a nightmare!

I...WANT-TO-PLAY-IN-THE-WATER-WITH-
EVERYONE. IT-SOUNDS...FUN.

Y'know...Monodam might be on to something.
I kinda wanna go in the pool now.
Yeah! Who cares about losing weight!?

Idiots! We're not here to play! We're here to
smack these bastards into the pits of hell!

We're the Monokubs! The meanest, nastiest,
cruelest mascots around!

If ya don't get it, I'll throw y'all into the
pool myself!
Ahhhhh! Please doooon't!

MONOSUKE, PLEASE-STOP...
CAN'T-WE-ALL-JUST-GET-ALONG?

Y-You sayin' that if we don't get along,
I'll end up like Monokid...?

So then...it was one of us that put the 
inner tube there, not the Monokubs?

Well, it doesn't matter. The inner tube 
probably isn't related to the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>Isn't related to the case?
If it were just for playing around, then...

<CLT=cltMIND>why is there a rope tied to it?
What could that be for?
<CLT=cltMIND>That is intriguing...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's an inner tube floating in the pool.
It looks like a big, sturdy, rubber one.

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's a rope tied to it...
What could that be for?
<CLT=cltMIND>That is intriguing...

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? There's something else
floating in the pool...
It looks like...a little piece of fabric.

It's just trash, right?
Nothing to be worried about.

We're looking for the culprit!
We don't have time to pick up trash!
Ah, yes, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps it's just my intuition,
but it does bother me.
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I should learn to trust it sometimes.
My intuition as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Black Piece of Fabric<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a little piece of fabric
floating in the pool...

Does that little piece of trash really bother
you that much?

Listen up! We're looking for the culprit!
We don't have time to pick up trash!
Ah, yes, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps it's just my intuition,
but it does bother me.

<CLT=cltMIND>This building is the school building. That 
must mean that that window goes somewhere.

<CLT=cltMIND>Most of the windows are blocked off,
but that one looks normal...

<CLT=cltMIND>What room has that window...?
That's a point of interest.

Hey, Shuichi... Does this pool really have 
anything to do with the case?

We got all psyched up about it, but it doesn't
seem like there were any clues here...
Well, that inner tube is still bothering me...

I don't know what it tells us,
but I feel like it's related to this case.

But, y'know...if that inner tube *is* related to
the case, the culprit is pretty careless...

If it was related to the case, 
why didn't they clean it up?

Just leaving it sitting out like that... 
don't you think that's straight-up careless?

No...even if they wanted to put it away,
they couldn't.

There's no pole or anything around here that
you could use to get the inner tube.

The water level is so low, you couldn't grab the
tube even if you did manage to bring it closer.

Then why not just jump in and fish it out 
by hand?

Oh! That's right! They couldn't get 
in the water!

<CLT=cltMIND>Couldn't get in the water...
Yes, I suppose you could think of it that way.

Well, we can't stay here forever, right?
Let's go check out the other places.

There's no time to waste!
Isn't that right, sidekick!?
Yeah, sure.
